module: Configurator of the quick race (quickrace) wizard: level, track, vehicle and settings (reverse, rolling start, lap count, time of day, seed). It builds a descriptor via quickRaceConfiguratorDescriptor (backend quickraceSelector, route key quickraceWizard, no race type or vehicle restriction) and passes it to oneshotRaceCore.createConfigurator. The returned module exposes the configurator API described in oneshotRaceCore.
notes: No default selection: the user chooses level, track and vehicle themselves.
